anki_estimated_daily_review_minutes.description: Estimated daily Anki review time in minutes

assignment_skip_patterns.description: Which assignment types get skipped most

auto_fixes.description: Validator-driven auto-repair audit trail. Appended by validate-state.py when it silently corrects state drift (e.g. schedule.last_session_date disagreeing with the most recent session log).

field.description: Dotted path of the field that was corrected (e.g. schedule.last_session_date)

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the fix was applied

average_session_duration_30d.description: Average session duration in minutes over 30 days

concepts_acquired_per_month.description: Trending down = plateau or pacing issue

concepts_in_practicing_simultaneously.description: Soft comfort target ~2; new-concept introduction is blocked at 3+ (4 with carryover) per the CLAUDE.md consolidation guardrail (validate-state check_consolidation_cap).

concepts_requiring_reteach_total.description: High value = bad sequencing or premature advancement

concepts_remaining_for_next_phase.description: Number of concepts still needed before phase transition

concepts_remaining_for_target_level.description: Number of concepts still needed to reach target CEFR level

current_acquisition_rate.description: Concepts acquired per week (30-day rolling average)

estimated_weeks_remaining.description: Rough estimate based on current acquisition rate and remaining concepts

last_goal_review.description: Date of last weekly review goal check

milestone_progress.description: List of {goal, status: pending|achieved|at-risk, target_date, notes}

last_validation_issues.description: Issues found during last validation run

learner_initiated_topics_30d.description: Are they bringing their own questions?

load_adjustments.description: Homework-load adjustment audit trail (LOAD-03/D-07/D-11). Appended by check-session-log.py on WARN-tier budget events and by the tutor on D-11 daily_target reductions; surfaced at weekly review for triage.

daily_maximum.description: daily_maximum at the time of the event

daily_target.description: daily_target at the time of the event

detected_by.description: Source that wrote the entry (script:function or 'tutor')

homework_sum.description: Summed estimated_minutes of the session's assignments

level.description: WARN (over daily_target) or the adjustment type (e.g. daily_target-reduction)

today_stretch.description: today_stretch at the time of the event

maintenance_sessions_total.description: Maintenance-mode only (post-Phase-D): cumulative count of maintenance sessions. Written by the tutor per maintenance-mode.md.

placement_validation_metrics.description: Placement validation effectiveness (populated after validation period closes)

total_concepts_validated.description: Number of concepts validated during placement

total_downgrades.description: Number of concept downgrades during validation

regressions_detected_in_maintenance.description: Maintenance-mode only: count of concept regressions caught during maintenance. Written by the tutor per maintenance-mode.md.

reteach_rate_30d.description: Percent of concepts that regressed after being acquired

session_difficulty_tracking.description: Tracks recent session difficulty ratings for calibration logic

consecutive_too_easy.description: Count of consecutive too-easy ratings (2+ triggers challenge increase)

consecutive_too_hard.description: Count of consecutive too-hard ratings (2+ triggers load reduction)

recent_ratings.description: Last 5 session difficulty ratings for trend analysis

sessions_rated_too_easy_30d.description: Sessions rated too-easy in last 30 days

sessions_rated_too_hard_30d.description: Sessions rated too-hard in last 30 days
